title: T06h — Upgrades that raise the schema version
goal: Admit candidates whose reader migrates the schema forward, with an explicit recovery to the operation backup
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: A forward migration is admitted only with a reviewed recovery that restores the operation backup and the previous revision on failure
Recovery never runs automatically without the owner; the previous revision is never started on migrated data
validation: Cross-version regressions; independent review; one owner-selected target trial
escalation: Any destructive restore, changed ownership or unresolved physical/worker effects requires explicit reconciliation; general restore remains F-062

effort.basis: Owner-approved split of the original T06 (4–6 focused days) into lettered slices on 2026-11-11, after the work had been delivered as unplanned slices; slices e–h use free step numbers because step IDs are two digits. Approved as separate: T06 does not wait for it, since nothing needs a schema raise today. Needs the general restore of F-062 first; uncertain until that design exists. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (upper bound of the range, rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 4.5 hours agent; former 3-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: 1.5 h/day judged rate (PR #277). Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 3 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 4.5 h → 2.75 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept. Estimate column backfilled 2026-11-12 at harness 7.0.0: estimateAgentHours = remaining plus actual so far (2.75 h); the baseline stays for calibration.
